title.narrative: In 2025, capacities of 5 state-level Governments were strengthened to utilize in-depth behavioural insights for their strategies. UNICEF supported an academic network to support the states on future research needs related to children's behaviours and social norms. SBC strategies of National Rural Livelihood Mission, Ministry of Tribal Affairs(MoTA) and the National Institute of Disaster Management (NIDM) were strengthened impacting across sectors. A new capacity building package for the workforce of NIDM was launched to strengthen community focused action plans for emergency preparedness.
